checks: Old saves get intact independent brake circuits; malformed values are bounded and snapshots do not alias fluid or lines.
A torn FL hose drains and disables only the FL/RR circuit; damage-off stops fluid loss and refilling cannot seal a leak.
Actual service braking loses stopping force and pulls under a diagonal failure; the mechanical handbrake remains available.
Wheel impacts damage local hoses and wheel detachment tears them; tyre replacement, tuning and save/reload preserve the hydraulic fault.
Repeated braking through the native solver heats the real discs into the glow range; cooling and replacement remove the glow.
Every vehicle has four independent rotor materials; only hot discs glow and condition diagnostics expose all hoses and both fluid reservoirs.
limits: Fictional diagonal circuit layout for all four cars; lumped pressure and separated fluid reservoirs, additional master cylinder, booster, ABS and fluid faults are covered in chassis-damage-v21-check.mjs.
Native pressure/temperature/geometry checks, no claim of real-car brake calibration.
